question: How many people were killed in the train derailment near Adamuz, Spain, in January 2026?

steps.content:
[2026 Adamuz rail disaster - Wikipedia] The incident killed 46 people including the Renfe train driver and injured 292 others, including 15 in critical condition. [3] The crash was Spain's worst railway disaster since the Santiago de Compostela derailment in 2013, [2][4] and the fourth deadliest railway accident ever recorded in the country. [5]
[2026 Adamuz rail disaster explained] On 18 January 2026, a high-speed passenger train derailed in the municipality of Adamuz, in the province of Córdoba, Spain. The derailment occurred on a straight section of the track that was last refurbished in May 2025. [1]
[Death toll climbs to 40 after high-speed train collision in Spain] Jan 19, 2026 · An aerial view of the site where a high-speed train carrying more than 300 passengers derailed and collided with another train traveling in the opposite direction near the town of Adamuz, in the southern Spanish province of Cordoba, January 19, 2026.

The train derailment near Adamuz, Spain, in January 2026 resulted in the deaths of 46 people. Additionally, 292 others were injured, with 15 in critical condition. This incident is noted as Spain's worst railway disaster since 2013. 

FINAL: 46 people were killed.
